title: Genesys Dice Forge
description: Dedicated native-WebGL 3D narrative dice module for the custom Genesys VTT system and standalone Genesys roll simulation. Premium physical dice, authentic face composition, natural deterministic face-up settling, always-on-top presentation, automatic Genesys roll bridge, overhand tabletop physics, adaptive dice audio, Foundry VTT 13.351 and Version 14.
